analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds a paragraph at head lines ~1960-1973. That paragraph says a JSON response_format (json_object/json_schema) on the Qwen template family defaults to a closed (non-thinking) reasoning block unless the caller sets a thinking control. It also says the coordinator prompt sidecar mirrors the rule so cache planning renders the same prompt. The supplied units are base text at 2423-2838 and head text at 1-416. The added paragraph itself is not visible in any supplied head excerpt, only in the patch. There is no code, no wire/protocol change, no auth, attestation, encryption or key handling change, and no new endpoint. The documented behavior changes prompt rendering (a default empty think block) for one family. Relevant threat IDs are T-041 (prefix cache) and A-001. If the underlying code changed prompt tokens, the coordinator-authored cacheSalt (account, model build, prompt-contract ID) must still reflect the prompt-contract change, and the sidecar and provider must stay in agreement. That is a contract-identity and cache-correctness integration question for the code files in other batches, not something this doc diff shows. Cache scoping remains coordinator-authored and caller-independent per T-041. I identified no security regression in the docs. Remaining question for code review: whether the Qwen35TemplateFix change bumps the request-normalization/prompt-contract identity, so stale cached prefixes cannot cross prompt renderings.
